title: Provider-neutral Forge seam with a GitHub adapter
summary: Introduces a provider-neutral `Forge` trait (branch, pull request, status block, review, check status, capabilities) plus a `report_change` engine step that runs those operations in one fixed order, an in-memory `FakeForge` double, and a `GitHub` adapter that drives the existing `gh` command line. The `osf` CLI's review-post, status-apply and status-refresh paths are rewired to go through the trait instead of calling `gh` directly, and `pr_status` is split into pure parsing (`parse_checks`, `gates_from_checks`) with the process work moved into the adapter.

lanes.label: osf CLI
lanes.subtitle: command entry points
lanes.summary: The `osf` binary's review and status commands now build a forge adapter and call the trait instead of shelling out themselves.

lanes.label: Forge core
lanes.subtitle: provider-neutral seam
lanes.summary: The new `forge` module: the trait, its data types, the ordered Report step, and the in-memory double.

lanes.label: Adapters
lanes.subtitle: code-host implementations
lanes.summary: The `GitHub` adapter over the `gh` command line, and the `FakeForge` test double.

nodes.label: osf CLI
nodes.subtitle: main.rs
nodes.summary: Command dispatch for `review post`, `review run --post-to`, `pr status apply` and `pr status refresh`. Each now constructs the GitHub adapter via `github_adapter()` and routes work through `forge::Forge`.

nodes.label: review post / run --post-to
nodes.subtitle: post_plan → forge.post_review
nodes.summary: Builds a `forge::NewReview` from the review plan and posts it through the trait; `report_outcome` now matches on `Result<PostedReview, ForgeError>` instead of the old `review::Outcome`.

nodes.label: pr status apply
nodes.subtitle: write_status_block
nodes.summary: Dry run still reads the body through the client; the real path now calls `forge.write_status_block`, which reads and rewrites the description inside the adapter.

nodes.label: pr status refresh
nodes.subtitle: gates + write via forge
nodes.summary: Gates now come from `forge.read_check_status` (or a `--checks-json` file) and the final write goes through `forge.write_status_block`.

nodes.label: Forge trait
nodes.subtitle: create_branch, open_pull_request, write_status_block, post_review, read_check_status, capabilities
nodes.summary: The provider-neutral seam. Object-safe, `Send + Sync`, and names no provider, URL or command. Its data types (`PullRequestId`, `NewReview`, `PostedReview`, `ReadOutcome`, `Capabilities`) carry the whole vocabulary.

nodes.label: report_change
nodes.subtitle: open → status block → capabilities → review → checks
nodes.summary: The engine's Report step as provider-neutral run code. Runs one fixed order, stops at the first failed step naming it, and skips the post when a known verdict list omits the draft verdict.

nodes.label: FakeForge
nodes.subtitle: in-memory double
nodes.summary: Records every call as plain data, scripts per-operation answers, and performs no process, file, network or clock work. Used by the report and full-run tests.

nodes.label: GitHub adapter
nodes.subtitle: GitHub<C: GhClient>
nodes.summary: Implements `Forge` over a `GhClient`: builds argv and JSON payloads, parses responses, classifies failures, and maps self-review refusals to an advisory comment. Also exposes `head_commit`.

nodes.label: RealGh
nodes.subtitle: spawns gh
nodes.summary: The only place that starts a process: runs `gh` with piped stdin/stdout, reads bodies, checks and review state, and edits the description through a temp file.

nodes.label: pr_status parsing
nodes.subtitle: parse_checks, gates_from_checks
nodes.summary: The status module is now pure: `parse_checks` returns `(name, state, bucket)` triples and `gates_from_checks` renders the gate spec; the `GhClient` trait gained a raw `run` method and lost its `RealGh` implementation.

nodes.label: review helpers
nodes.subtitle: payload, after_first_attempt, parse_head_sha_json
nodes.summary: The pure review decision code stays; `parse_head_sha_json` is now public so the adapter can reuse it, and the module no longer runs commands itself.

nodes.label: gh command line
nodes.subtitle: installed tool
nodes.summary: The installed command-line tool the adapter drives; unchanged, but now reached from exactly one module.

nodes.label: Code host
nodes.subtitle: pull requests, reviews, checks
nodes.summary: The remote service holding branches, pull requests, reviews and check runs.

edges.label: github_adapter()

edges.label: post_review

edges.label: write_status_block

edges.label: read_check_status / write_status_block
edges.summary: Gates come from the forge's check read and the final description write goes through the trait.

edges.label: &dyn Forge
edges.summary: The Report step takes the trait object and calls its six operations in one fixed order.

edges.label: impl Forge
edges.summary: The adapter is the first implementation of the trait; nothing above it names the provider.

edges.label: GhClient::run
edges.summary: Every adapter operation goes through the injected client, so tests can substitute a fake.

edges.label: spawn
edges.summary: The only process spawn in the crate.

edges.label: API calls
edges.summary: The tool talks to the remote host; the factory never does directly.

edges.label: impl Forge
edges.summary: The double implements the same trait with no side effects.

edges.label: parse_checks, apply
